name: MP Teammate View
author: sentou-koubou (based on BAKAOLC / OLC)
description: Multiplayer QoL: teammate potions + hand cards next to the player list. Settings (scale/offset/highlights/toggle key), LemonSpire/Typing Alt+click share. Combined rewrite of MultiPlayerPotionView + ShowPlayerHandCards with reliable hand attach. Disable the original two Workshop mods if both are installed. Requires STS2-RitsuLib.
